features.name: ExtremeRouter state survives rebuild+reboot
features.behavior: API keys and OAuth integrations configured in the ExtremeRouter UI persist across rebuilds and reboots
verification: nix eval confirms environment.persistence."/persist" covers the extreme-router state path
podman inspect extreme-router shows all app write paths bind-mounted from /var/lib/containers or /persist
image reference is pinned by digest (no :latest)
systemctl restart podman-extreme-router && configured providers still present
evidence: Verified docker image digest pinned to @sha256:b710a8164939b64aebbbc3bff863a361e10367dd7b556f5159e0d81fe6b2fb3f in extreme-router.nix.
Verified oci-container volume mount mapping /var/lib/extreme-router:/app/data via nix eval.
Added /var/lib/extreme-router to canonical impermanence system directories in layers/10-system/15-filesystem/impermanence.nix.

features.name: AionUi persists data and login survives reboot
features.behavior: AionUi runs as a non-root user, /var/lib/aionui is persisted, Workflows/models are saved
verification: systemctl show aionui -p User shows non-root user
grep -q environment.persistence layers/20-services/22-ai/aionui.nix
after reboot: login works with previously created credentials

features.name: Mission Control image pinned and data persisted
features.behavior: mission-control OCI container uses a digest-pinned image and its data directory is persisted under /persist
verification: grep '@sha256:' layers/20-services/22-ai/mission-control.nix
grep -q environment.persistence layers/20-services/22-ai/mission-control.nix

features.name: AionUi detects coding agents
features.behavior: The aionui service environment resolves claude, codex, gemini, and opencode binaries in PATH
verification: systemctl show aionui -p Environment contains the per-user profile path
systemd-run --pipe -p User=t0psh31f which claude codex gemini opencode exits 0

features.name: Skill packs live in repo and reach both agents
features.behavior: Canonical skills under layers/70-agents/skills/ are symlinked into OpenCode and Hermes config paths
verification: ls layers/70-agents/skills/ shows at least 3 SKILL.md packs
readlink ~/.hermes/skills/harness-session-protocol resolves into the repo checkout
opencode debug config lists the skills directory

features.name: machine.tags validated against a registry
features.behavior: Duplicate tag profiles merged (dev/development, media/media-server) and tag assignments typed
verification: ls layers/90-profiles/tags/ shows no duplicate-purpose profiles

features.name: No hardcoded provider URLs in agent configs
features.behavior: opencode.nix and antigravity.nix reference owning modules' port options instead of raw IP/port strings
